sync.notification.channel_name.description: Notification channel name for the background sync engine (conflict alerts and the expedited-sync progress notification).

sync.notification.channel_description.value: Alerts about changes synced from other devices.
sync.notification.channel_description.description: Notification channel description shown in the system notification settings.

sync.notification.syncing.description: Text of the low-importance progress notification shown while an expedited sync runs as a foreground task on older Android versions.

sync.notification.conflict_title.description: Title of the conflict notification fired when a pulled remote change wins over a local pending edit.

sync.notification.conflict_rebased.value: '{title}' was changed on another device — your edit to {fields} was re-applied over that change.
sync.notification.conflict_rebased.description: Conflict notification body when the local pending edit was rebased on top of a newer remote row and re-queued. {title} is the record name (customer/party/item), {fields} the comma-joined changed field names.

sync.notification.conflict_dropped.value: '{title}' was changed on another device — your edit to {fields} was overridden.
sync.notification.conflict_dropped.description: Conflict notification body when the local pending operation lost to a newer remote change and was discarded. {title} is the record name, {fields} the comma-joined overridden field names.

sync.banner.conflict.value: A change from another device replaced a local edit. Review it in Sync status.
sync.banner.conflict.description: In-app banner text shown while unacknowledged sync conflicts exist; tapping opens Settings → Sync status.

invoice.title.description: Localized 'Invoice' document title in the PDF header band and the text receipt.

invoice.number_label.description: Label preceding the immutable invoice number ({prefix}-{YYYY}-{counter}) on the PDF and text receipt.

invoice.issue_date_label.description: Label for the invoice issue date in the PDF header band and the text receipt.

invoice.billed_to.description: Bold label above the customer name/phone block on the invoice.

invoice.event_label.description: Label for the event block (event type and dates) on the invoice and text receipt.

invoice.total_amount.description: Amounts-block row label for the booking's total amount.

invoice.security_deposit.description: Amounts-block row label for the refundable security deposit; the row appears only when the deposit is greater than zero.

invoice.payment_history.description: Section title above the itemized payments table.

invoice.table.date.description: Payments-table column header: date the payment was made.

invoice.table.notes.description: Payments-table column header: free-text note on the payment.

invoice.total_paid.description: Bold footer row of the payments table showing the sum of all payments.

invoice.balance_due.description: Label in the tonal balance band: total amount minus total paid, computed at render time.

invoice.fully_paid.description: Note shown next to a zero balance due (rendered in green).

invoice.no_payments.description: Placeholder row shown in the payment history when the booking has no payments.

invoice.footer.description: Centered grey footer line on the PDF and the last line of the text receipt.

invoice.method.cash.description: Localized payment-method label for 'cash' in the payments table.

invoice.method.upi.description: Localized payment-method label for 'upi' in the payments table (kept as the UPI brand acronym in every locale).

invoice.method.bank_transfer.description: Localized payment-method label for 'bank_transfer' in the payments table.

invoice.method.cheque.description: Localized payment-method label for 'cheque' in the payments table.

invoice.method.other.description: Localized payment-method label for 'other' in the payments table.
